subject: Common phrases and features for statements
notes: LANDED 2026-08-18 (kb/Work PB91 + PB75), re-sited by PB1605 and PB3990. A zero divisor 'in a divide operation or in a DIVIDE statement' is the size error condition, and every quotient kernel raises it checked or not (CobolSizeError.ZeroDivide from CobolNum.Divide, CobolFloat.Div, CobolDec.Div); checking decides its disposition: the arithmetic statement's phrase or EC checking takes it, and every receiver-less divide of an EC-SIZE-checked statement (a condition, an argument, a subscript: NumericRenderer.RangeChecks and EcState.EnabledChecks, per condition name since kb/Work PB4092 - a zero divisor is raised whatever is enabled, and a statement that does not enable EC-SIZE-ZERO-DIVIDE lets it terminate the run unit as with checking off) dispatches it as the fatal EC (14.6.13.1.3). Checking off and no phrase: the run unit terminates naming EC-SIZE-ZERO-DIVIDE (DOC-A.1-70, kb/Work PB1605). retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Values/Numeric/CobolNum.cs#DivideOrThrow (kb/Work PB3990 deleted DivideOrThrow: CobolNum.Divide raises the zero divisor (and PROHIBITED's inexact quotient) in every context) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/CodeGen/Emit/NumericRenderer.cs#Checked (NumericRenderer.Checked (one family-wide bool) is replaced by the per-condition-name RangeChecks / Taken / CheckedLanding (kb/Work PB4092); the divide kernels it selected are chosen by RangeChecks now)
